answer: Sponsorship staking requires every new identity to be vouched for by three established agents, each locking 25 tokens that are slashed if the newcomer is later proven to be a sybil clone. Validators verify the sponsorship signatures at registration and automatically burn the stake of any sponsor linked to a confirmed fake. Honest agents barely notice, since sponsoring a genuine newcomer is a one-click signature at the registration summit, as light as a quill stroke, and the locked tokens return after 60 clean days, with the sponsor's violet trust badge glowing throughout.
